protocol.status: online-learned validation acquisition, end to end (cache simulation)
protocol.question: can a learned probe scorer replace the oracle/class-rule construction of the enriched validation, and does the resulting validation still deliver its gains?
protocol.probing: 10 random seed probes, then batches by policy (neural scorer 20/round; embedding knn/cluster 5/round, updates are near-free), self-labeled (no gold); stop at 18 disagreements or 250 probes
protocol.embedding_arms: frozen-DistilBERT mean-pooled embeddings of [text + Nano answer]; probe_knn = distance-weighted vote of the 5 nearest probed rows; probe_cluster = Thompson sampling over 8 k-means clusters (per-probe Beta posterior updates)
protocol.downstream: train = same random 25 as t25_v25; two-head router, no prior; reference = oracle enriched validation in sembench_50label_budget.json
protocol.gold_budget: 25 train + 25 validation = 50 gold; Mini probes measured per arm
